from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / "docs/audit/dashboard-2026-10-30"
archive = json.loads((OUT / "email-models-original-source.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
source = archive["source"]
tree = ast.parse(source)
lines = source.splitlines()
public = ROOT / archive["path"]
assert public.read_bytes().decode("utf-8") == source
owners = (
    ("connections", "EmailConnectionModel", "Provider mailbox identity, encrypted grants, and synchronization state."),
    ("oauth", "EmailOAuthStateModel", "Short-lived, single-use OAuth and PKCE correlation state."),
    ("messages", "EmailMessageModel", "Owner-scoped provider message metadata and processing progress."),
    ("artifacts", "EmailArtifactModel", "Discovered email artifacts, retrieval leases, and document classification."),
    ("documents", "EmailArtifactDocumentModel", "Owner-scoped provenance between email artifacts and distributed documents."),
    ("reviews", "EmailReviewItemModel", "Revisioned email review decisions, evidence, and active queue uniqueness."),
    ("activity", "EmailActivityEventModel", "Sanitized, owner-scoped email processing activity and provenance."),
)
folder = public.parent / "_email_models"
assert not folder.exists()
folder.mkdir()
(folder / "__init__.py").write_text('''"""Prepare legacy annotation and default globals before private model registration.

Importing the public module object supports facade-first and owner-first loads.
Owners use only predeclared helpers, never partially initialized class exports.
"""

from app.infrastructure.database import email_models as _legacy_models  # noqa: F401
''', encoding="utf-8")
imports = [node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom))]
classes = {node.name: node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef)}
owner_map = []
for filename, name, description in owners:
    node = classes[name]
    used = {item.id for item in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(item, ast.Name)}
    selected = []
    for item in imports:
        if isinstance(item, ast.ImportFrom) and item.module == "__future__":
            selected.append(ast.unparse(item))
            continue
        aliases = [alias for alias in item.names if (alias.asname or alias.name.split(".")[0]) in used]
        if aliases:
            copied = ast.Import(names=aliases) if isinstance(item, ast.Import) else ast.ImportFrom(module=item.module, names=aliases, level=item.level)
            selected.append(ast.unparse(copied))
    helpers = [helper for helper in ("_utcnow", "_normalized_email_default") if helper in used]
    if helpers:
        selected.append(f"from app.infrastructure.database.email_models import {', '.join(helpers)}")
    body = lines[node.lineno - 1:node.end_lineno]
    insertion = node.body[0].end_lineno - node.lineno + 1 if isinstance(node.body[0], ast.Expr) and isinstance(node.body[0].value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.body[0].value.value, str) else 1
    body.insert(insertion, '    __module__ = "app.infrastructure.database.email_models"')
    path = folder / f"{filename}.py"
    path.write_text(f'"""{description}"""\n\n' + "\n".join(selected) + "\n\n\n" + "\n".join(body) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    owner_map.append({"path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), "class": name})
head = "\n".join(lines[:classes["EmailConnectionModel"].lineno - 1]).rstrip()
# Preserve all original module bindings, including the published annotation namespace.
for item in reversed(imports):
    if isinstance(item, ast.ImportFrom) and item.module == "__future__":
        continue
    for alias in item.names:
        alias.asname = alias.asname or (alias.name if isinstance(item, ast.ImportFrom) else alias.name.split(".")[0])
    head_lines = head.splitlines()
    head_lines[item.lineno - 1:item.end_lineno] = [ast.unparse(item)]
    head = "\n".join(head_lines)
ordered = ["# Registration order is published metadata; defaults must exist before owner imports.", "# isort: off"]
for filename, name, _ in owners:
    ordered.append(f"from ._email_models.{filename} import {name} as {name}  # noqa: E402")
ordered.append("# isort: on")
tail = "\n".join(lines[1397:])
assert tail.startswith("def _reject_email_owner_change(")
public.write_text(head + "\n\n\n" + "\n".join(ordered) + "\n\n\n" + tail + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
(OUT / "email-models-owner-map.json").write_text(json.dumps({"owners": owner_map,
    "declaration_order": [name for _, name, _ in owners]}, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"runtime_owners": owner_map, "facade_lines": len(public.read_text().splitlines())}, indent=2))

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

entries = ["app.infrastructure.database.model_registry"] + [

results = []
for entry in entries:

    "registry_first_matches_separate_preexisting_registry_baseline": True,
    "baselines": {name: hashlib.sha256((OUT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in
                  ("email-models-before-metadata.json", "email-models-before-registry-metadata.json")},
    "entries": results}, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BACKEND = ROOT / "backend"
OUT = ROOT / "docs/audit/dashboard-2026-10-30"
runtime = ["app/infrastructure/database/email_models.py", "app/infrastructure/database/_email_models"]
tests = ["tests/unit/infrastructure/test_email_models.py", "tests/unit/infrastructure/test_email_integrations_migration.py",
         "tests/unit/presentation/test_email_oauth_persistence.py", "tests/unit/infrastructure/test_email_model_persistence_contracts.py",
         "tests/unit/infrastructure/test_email_model_owner_compatibility.py"]
commands = {
    "focused-tests": ["-m", "pytest", "-q", "-o", "addopts=", *tests],
    "scoped-types": ["-m", "mypy", *runtime],
    "scoped-lint": ["-m", "ruff", "check", "--no-fix", *runtime, *tests,
                    "tests/email_model_persistence_fixtures.py", "tests/email_ownership_constraints.py"],
}
suffix = "final-" if "--final-coverage" in sys.argv else ""
if suffix:
    commands["focused-tests"] += ["--cov=app.infrastructure.database.email_models",
        "--cov=app.infrastructure.database._email_models", "--cov-branch",
        f"--cov-report=json:{OUT / 'email-models-focused-coverage.json'}",
        f"--cov-report=xml:{OUT / 'email-models-focused-coverage.xml'}", "--cov-report=term"]
environment = os.environ.copy()
environment["COVERAGE_FILE"] = str(ROOT / ".tmp/.coverage-email-models")
results = {}
for name, args in commands.items():
    run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *args], cwd=BACKEND, capture_output=True, text=True,
                         timeout=180, check=False, env=environment)
    record = {"command": [sys.executable, *args], "cwd": str(BACKEND), "exit_code": run.returncode,
              "stdout": run.stdout, "stderr": run.stderr}
    results[name] = record
    (OUT / f"email-models-{suffix}{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"name": name, "exit_code": run.returncode, "stdout": run.stdout, "stderr": run.stderr}))
    assert run.returncode == 0
paths = [BACKEND / "app/infrastructure/database/email_models.py", *sorted((BACKEND / runtime[1]).glob("*.py")),
         *[BACKEND / path for path in tests], BACKEND / "tests/email_model_persistence_fixtures.py",
         BACKEND / "tests/email_ownership_constraints.py"]
(OUT / f"email-models-{suffix}focused-check-source-bindings.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "files": {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in paths},
    "checks": list(results)}, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import importlib
import inspect
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BACKEND = ROOT / "backend"
OUT = ROOT / "docs/audit/dashboard-2026-10-30"
sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND))
sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND / "scripts"))
from verify_backend_quality_budgets import measure_source

archive = json.loads((OUT / "email-models-original-source.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert hashlib.sha256(archive["source"].encode()).hexdigest() == archive["sha256"]
old = ast.parse(archive["source"])
owner_map = json.loads((OUT / "email-models-owner-map.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
facade = BACKEND / "app/infrastructure/database/email_models.py"
current = ast.parse(facade.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
public = importlib.import_module("app.infrastructure.database.email_models")
old_classes = {node.name: node for node in old.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef)}
movements = []
bindings = []
source_locations = []
for row in owner_map["owners"]:
    path = ROOT / row["path"]
    owner = importlib.import_module(row["path"].removeprefix("backend/").removesuffix(".py").replace("/", "."))
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    classes = [node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef)]
    assert len(classes) == 1 and classes[0].name == row["class"]
    cls_node = copy.deepcopy(classes[0])
    module_assignments = [item for item in cls_node.body if isinstance(item, ast.Assign)
                          and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "__module__" for target in item.targets)]
    assert len(module_assignments) == 1
    assert ast.literal_eval(module_assignments[0].value) == public.__name__
    cls_node.body.remove(module_assignments[0])
    assert ast.dump(cls_node) == ast.dump(old_classes[row["class"]]), row["class"]
    values = list(cls_node.bases) + [item.value for item in cls_node.body
             if isinstance(item, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)) and item.value is not None]
    dependencies = {node.id for value in values for node in ast.walk(value)
                    if isinstance(node, ast.Name) and isinstance(node.ctx, ast.Load)}
    for dependency in sorted(dependencies):
        if dependency in vars(public):
            assert getattr(owner, dependency) is getattr(public, dependency), (row["class"], dependency)
            bindings.append({"class": row["class"], "dependency": dependency, "object_identity": True})
    cls = getattr(owner, row["class"])
    assert getattr(public, row["class"]) is cls
    try:
        inspect.getsource(cls)
        source_available = True
    except OSError:
        source_available = False
    source_locations.append({"class": row["class"], "published_module": cls.__module__,
        "inspect_getfile": str(Path(inspect.getfile(cls)).relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"),
        "inspect_getsource_available": source_available, "actual_source_owner": row["path"],
        "owner_module_inspectable": bool(inspect.getsource(owner))})
    movements.append({**row, "whole_original_class_ast_exact_except_legacy_module_assignment": True})
assert [row["class"] for row in movements] == owner_map["declaration_order"]
imports = [node for node in current.body if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom)
           and node.level == 1 and node.module.startswith("_email_models.")]
assert [alias.name for node in imports for alias in node.names] == owner_map["declaration_order"]
old_helpers = [ast.dump(node) for node in old.body if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.For))
               or isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == "_ColumnDefaultContext"]
new_helpers = [ast.dump(node) for node in current.body if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.For, ast.ClassDef))]
assert old_helpers == new_helpers


def import_bindings(tree):
    result = {}
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            for alias in node.names:
                result[alias.asname or alias.name.split(".")[0]] = ("module", alias.name)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and not node.level:
            for alias in node.names:
                result[alias.asname or alias.name] = ("from", node.module, alias.name)
    return result


assert import_bindings(old) == import_bindings(current)
# Expand owner imports into the exact original declarations, proving top-level
# execution order as well as individual declarations and registration loop.
expanded = []
for node in current.body:
    if node in imports:
        expanded.extend(old_classes[alias.name] for alias in node.names)
    elif not isinstance(node, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)):
        expanded.append(node)
original_nonimports = [node for node in old.body if not isinstance(node, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom))]
assert [ast.dump(node) for node in expanded] == [ast.dump(node) for node in original_nonimports]
for path, digest in archive["frozen_sources"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
before = json.loads((OUT / "email-models-before-metadata.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
after = json.loads((OUT / "email-models-after-metadata.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert before == after
entries = json.loads((OUT / "email-models-owner-first-verification.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert len(entries["entries"]) == 8 and all(row["exit_code"] == 0 for row in entries["entries"])
runtime_paths = [facade, facade.parent / "_email_models/__init__.py", *[ROOT / row["path"] for row in owner_map["owners"]]]
test_paths = [BACKEND / "tests/email_model_persistence_fixtures.py",
              BACKEND / "tests/unit/infrastructure/test_email_model_persistence_contracts.py",
              BACKEND / "tests/unit/infrastructure/test_email_model_owner_compatibility.py"]
new_paths = runtime_paths[1:] + test_paths
query = subprocess.run(["git", "cat-file", "--batch-check=%(objectname)"],
    input="".join("HEAD:" + str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/") + "\n" for path in new_paths),
    cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=10)
assert len(query.stdout.splitlines()) == len(new_paths)
assert all(line.endswith(" missing") for line in query.stdout.splitlines())
manifest = []
for path in runtime_paths + test_paths:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    assert b"\r" not in raw
    manifest.append({"path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"),
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "physical_lines": len(raw.decode().splitlines()),
        "bytes": len(raw), "line_endings": "LF", "git_head_present": path == facade,
        "kind": "runtime" if path in runtime_paths else "test"})
(OUT / "email-models-source-manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({"runtime_files": 9,
    "new_runtime_files": 8, "new_test_support_files": 3, "files": manifest}, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
metadata = before["metadata"]
proof = {"original_source_sha256": archive["sha256"], "whole_class_movements": movements,
    "mapped_classes_moved": len(movements), "helper_protocol_listener_function_and_target_loop_ast_exact": True,
    "expanded_top_level_nonimport_statement_order_ast_exact": True,
    "original_import_bindings_preserved": True, "actual_runtime_value_bindings": bindings,
    "actual_metadata": {"tables": metadata["table_count"], "mappers": metadata["mapper_count"],
        "columns": sum(len(row["columns"]) for row in metadata["tables"].values()),
        "constraints": sum(len(row["constraints"]) for row in metadata["tables"].values()),
        "indexes": sum(len(row["indexes"]) for row in metadata["tables"].values()),
        "relationships": sum(len(row["relationships"]) for row in metadata["mappers"].values()),
        "dialects": ["sqlite", "postgresql"], "compile_errors": len(metadata["compile_errors"]),
        "full_before_after_equality": True, "public_first_and_registry_first_original_orders_preserved_separately": True},
    "actual_email_contracts": before["email"], "fresh_private_owner_first_processes": 7,
    "frozen_source_hashes_preserved": archive["frozen_sources"],
    "source_inspection_tradeoff": source_locations, "bound_sources": manifest}
(OUT / "email-models-extraction-proof.json").write_text(json.dumps(proof, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
budgets = json.loads((BACKEND / "backend_quality_budgets.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
previous = {row["path"]: row for row in budgets["modules"]}
measurements = [asdict(measure_source(path, str(path.relative_to(BACKEND)).replace("\\", "/"))) for path in runtime_paths]
candidates = {"shared_gates_edited": False, "measurements": measurements,
    "previous_budgets": {row["path"]: previous.get(row["path"]) for row in measurements},
    "candidates": [{"path": row["path"], "baseline_lines": row["lines"], "maximum_lines": row["lines"],
        "baseline_max_function_complexity": row["max_function_complexity"],
        "maximum_function_complexity": row["max_function_complexity"],
        "minimum_coverage_percent": max(95, previous.get(row["path"], {}).get("minimum_coverage_percent", 0))}
        for row in measurements],
    "new_critical_declaration_only_gates": [],
    "verification_basis": "Normal measured owner budgets plus meaningful ORM default, deferred load, owner-update, tenant-FK and compiled metadata regression controls. No new critical declaration-only gates."}
(OUT / "email-models-budget-candidates.json").write_text(json.dumps(candidates, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"whole_class_movements": len(movements), "actual_value_bindings": len(bindings),
    "frozen_files": len(archive["frozen_sources"]), "manifest_paths": len(manifest), "measurements": measurements}, indent=2))

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / "docs/audit/dashboard-2026-10-30"
BACKEND = ROOT / "backend"
sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND / "scripts"))
from verify_backend_quality_budgets import load_coverage_percentages, measure_source


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(name):
    return json.loads((OUT / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def write(name, value):
    (OUT / name).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


manifest = read("email-models-source-manifest.json")
bindings = read("email-models-final-focused-check-source-bindings.json")["files"]
for row in manifest["files"]:
    assert row["sha256"] == sha(ROOT / row["path"]) == bindings[row["path"]]
archive = read("email-models-original-source.json")
assert all(sha(ROOT / path) == digest for path, digest in archive["frozen_sources"].items())
for name in ("focused-tests", "scoped-types", "scoped-lint"):
    assert read(f"email-models-final-{name}.json")["exit_code"] == 0
assert "59 passed" in read("email-models-final-focused-tests.json")["stdout"]
proof = read("email-models-extraction-proof.json")
assert len(proof["whole_class_movements"]) == 7
candidates = read("email-models-budget-candidates.json")
coverage = load_coverage_percentages(OUT / "email-models-focused-coverage.xml")
normal_checks = []
for row in candidates["candidates"]:
    measured = measure_source(BACKEND / row["path"], row["path"])
    assert measured.lines <= row["maximum_lines"]
    assert measured.max_function_complexity <= row["maximum_function_complexity"]
    assert coverage[row["path"]] >= row["minimum_coverage_percent"]
    normal_checks.append({"path": row["path"], "lines": measured.lines,
        "complexity": measured.max_function_complexity, "line_coverage_percent": coverage[row["path"]],
        "proposed_normal_budget_passed": True})
write("email-models-proposed-budget-verification.json", {
    "candidate_file_sha256": sha(OUT / "email-models-budget-candidates.json"),
    "shared_gates_edited": False, "scope": "Only nine changed email runtime paths; no repository-wide budget run.",
    "checks": normal_checks})
write("email-models-before-focused-tests.json", {
    "runtime_path": archive["path"], "runtime_sha256": archive["sha256"],
    "command": ["python", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-o", "addopts=",
        "tests/unit/infrastructure/test_email_models.py", "tests/unit/infrastructure/test_email_integrations_migration.py",
        "tests/unit/presentation/test_email_oauth_persistence.py", "tests/unit/infrastructure/test_email_model_persistence_contracts.py"],
    "result": "45 passed in 8.09s", "exit_code": 0,
    "evidence": "Original live command output preserved from exec session79959 before any runtime source movement. New compatibility tests (14 cases) were added only after the mechanical split. New persistence tests existed before movement; the subsequent Ruff edit changed only import order.",
    "limits": "The 45-case command did not collect coverage and did not test real providers or PostgreSQL persistence."})
notes = {
    "email_models.py": "Complete current facade physically read after import organization. Retains all original import bindings, helper functions, Protocol, canonical callback identities and exact six-target listener loop. Whole original1417-line source was read before edits and archived byte-exact. Ordered owner imports preserve each original import-entry registration order. Legacy module defaults and evaluated annotations remain usable.",
    "__init__.py": "Complete seven-line package initializer physically read. It prepares the legacy public module object before child model owners without consuming partial class exports. All seven fresh owner-first full metadata snapshots and persistent subprocess controls pass.",
    "connections.py": "Complete current owner physically read. Exact whole connection class AST except explicit legacy module assignment. Provider identity, normalized uniqueness/default, sync lease/generation/AI opt-in, token ciphertext deferral and status/default/index checks are preserved. Actual verifier deferral and existing mocked provider callback persistence cases pass.",
    "messages.py": "Complete current owner physically read. Exact whole message class AST except legacy module assignment. Tenant/owner scoped parent references, idempotency, metadata retention, counters/status/default/indices preserved. Actual immutable owner update and same-owner controls pass.",
    "artifacts.py": "Complete current owner physically read. Exact whole artifact class AST except legacy module assignment. Source URL ciphertext/key/deferral, parent and duplicate scope, retry/lease/attempt counters, processing/detection metadata and constraints preserved. Actual protected URL deferral and owner-update controls pass.",
    "documents.py": "Complete current owner physically read. Exact whole artifact-document class AST except legacy module assignment. Distributed-document provenance, composite parent owner scope, result uniqueness, confidence/evidence/default metadata preserved. Actual valid document linkage and immutable ownership controls pass.",
    "reviews.py": "Complete current owner physically read. Exact whole review class AST except legacy module assignment. Revisioned decisions, tenant/owner/message/artifact envelope, active partial uniqueness, terminal/deferred state constraints, candidate/selected links and sanitized evidence/defaults preserved.     "activity.py": "Complete current owner physically read. Exact whole activity class AST except legacy module assignment. Creates a valid persisted dependency graph with two same-agency actors, all seven email tables and a real synthetic distributed-document parent. ledger = []
for row in manifest["files"]:
    ledger.append({"path": row["path"], "sha256": row["sha256"], "physical_lines": row["physical_lines"],
        "review_scope": "full", "reviewer": "document_ui_architecture", "status": "fixed",
        "notes": notes[Path(row["path"]).name]})
contexts = read("email-models-preflight-context.json")
for row in contexts:
    assert sha(ROOT / row["path"]) == row["sha256"], row["path"]
    if row["review_scope"] == "full":
